text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-01",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-01 through OP-07 cite a sentence on page 51 ('no other data will be collected') that does not specify the target days, period groups, or timepoint labels for Visits 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 7.1, 7.2, 7.3, and 8.1; those schedule details appear in Table 1 on page 44."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-07",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-07 sets Visit 8.1 to Day 91, whereas Table 1 (page 44) and Section 6.2.5 (page 51) specify Visit 8.1 at Day 90 (480 h after the Day 70 administration)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-02",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-02, OP-03, OP-06, and OP-07 omit visit windows, whereas Table 1 (page 44) specifies ±1 day for V2.2, V2.3, and V7.3, and ±2 days for V8.1 (additionally, Section 6.2.5 on page 51 specifies ±1 hour for 48 h [V2.1, V7.1] and ±24 hours for 144 h–480 h [V2.2, V2.3, V7.2, V7.3, V8.1])."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds '48 h', '144 h', and '240 h' to codelist PKTPT, but omits the '480 h' timepoint required for Visit 8.1 (Day 90) per Section 6.2.5."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-10",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 36,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "DYN_PK_01 triggers the PK substudy visits whenever PKSUB = 'Yes' (consent to participate), whereas the protocol (pages 36-37 and 51) states that PK substudy consent is collected on all patients for stratification while only 24 Mainland China patients electronically assigned at randomisation enter the PK subgroup."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-15",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-15 creates the new ADA form and assigns it only to V3, V4, V6, and V8, omitting Visit 2 (Baseline) and Visit 9 (Safety Follow-up) where anti-TJ301 antibody blood sampling is also required per Table 1 (page 45) and Sections 6.2.3/6.3 (pages 50, 52)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-18",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-17 and OP-18 create a single combined Yes/No item on the new DIARY form and assign it only to V2, omitting separate tracking of dispensing vs. review and omitting all other scheduled diary visits (V1, V1.1, V3–V7, and V8 review only) shown in Table 1."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": "OP-21",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-19 through OP-21 create a new PE form containing only body weight and assign it only to V4, V6, and V8, omitting V1.1 (weight only) as well as V1 and V9 (complete physical examination and height at V1) per Table 1 and Footnote i (pages 45-46)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-23",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Protocol Section 4.1.1 (page 34), Table 1 Footnote c (page 45), and the first paragraph of page 49 require screening endoscopy at Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation, whereas the third paragraph of page 49 still states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable' (and Footnote b on page 45 says 'within 35 days', which could allow Day -5 to -1)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-24",
      "change_id": "CH-12",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-24 enforces an exact 2-hour infusion check (`hours_between != 2`) with zero tolerance, contradicting the protocol amendment rationale on page 94 which removed '±3 min' specifically because sites find it difficult to control dosing time within ±3 minutes."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-11",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-21",
      "page": 87,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "No operation updates the VIRO or TB forms (which currently contain only single free-text result fields VIRORES and TBRES) to capture the specific screening assays added in CH-21 and CH-10, such as QuantiFERON-TB Gold vs. T-spot plus chest X-ray, EBV VCA-IgM/VCA-IgG, and CMV DNA load."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Because the current casebook models eligibility (IE) as a single overall Yes/No flag and already included 2 h PKTPT, RAND stratification fields, and V9 TB testing prior to this diff, I could not verify whether granular criterion-level updates for CH-9 and CH-10 were expected or intentionally out of scope."
}
